MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The microSD card feels useful because I already have a Raspberry Pi and have bought memory cards; more room could support another project if the card is compatible.",
    "The gigabit router connects to my recent Ethernet adapter and cable purchases, although I would need to confirm that my current router needs replacing."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks, tablet and gaming bundle add devices without helping me finish or maintain my current computer and Raspberry Pi setup.",
    "The extender and mesh system assume a wireless coverage problem I have not shown, while my recent networking purchases support wired connections.",
    "The sport earbuds do not follow the desk listening needs suggested by my headphones and under-desk mount, and the 16TB drive offers capacity beyond any storage need I have shown."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been taken as interest in almost any popular electronic device, regardless of what I would use it for.",
    "My networking and Raspberry Pi purchases seem to have been stretched into broad interest in Wi-Fi equipment and gaming products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases fit together around a wired, organized and well-maintained computer workspace: Ethernet cables, an adapter, a headphone mount and a blower duster.",
    "I often buy practical accessories for equipment I already own, so a useful addition with clear compatibility matters more than a new device or a large upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and networking interests but missed that I am mainly improving existing equipment for specific projects."
}
